content.introduction: According to Bloomberg's Sector & Industry Performance data, as of November 6, 2026, the Information Technology sector has the highest percentage change at 1.26%, followed by Consumer Staples at 1.21%. The Financials sector has a 0.68% change, while Utilities and Materials sectors show the highest positive changes among others at 0.59% and 0.51% respectively. The overall All Sectors index has a slight increase of 0.31%. The data is last updated as of November 6, 2026, 05:19 PM.
